notes.title: FreedroidRPG 1.0 RC 3 is out!
notes.content:
RC 3 is out, and along translation updates and several bugfixes, we also did several minor improvements:

[list]
[*]You can now scroll the quest log with up/down arrow keys
[*]Several tweaks were done to prevent overlap between text and numbers
[*]More sound effects were added by pekpek
[*]A new soundtrack, which can be heard in Act 2 Factory, also by pekpek.
[/list]

A total of 67 commits were done since 12 May 2019 (RC 2). We hope to provide the most stable experience possible, but if you identify a bug in the wild, don't forget to report!

Don't let the bots get to you!
FreedroidRPG Team
